{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01CTci8fbj2756WPhG1VpDeK","type":"tool_result","content":[{"type":"text","text":"## SQLite Database Schema Report\n\nThe `/app/oewn.sqlite` database contains **24 tables** representing a comprehensive lexical/wordnet database structure. Here's the complete schema:\n\n### Tables and Structure\n\n**Core Concept Tables:**\n- `synsets` - Word sense definitions with POS (part-of-speech) and domain information\n- `words` - Base word forms\n- `casedwords` - Case-sensitive variants of words\n- `poses` - Part-of-speech categories (noun, verb, adjective, etc.)\n- `domains` - Semantic domains for synsets\n\n**Linguistic Details:**\n- `pronunciations` - Phonetic pronunciations\n- `morphs` - Morphological forms\n- `adjpositions` - Adjective positions (attributive, predicative, postnominal)\n\n**Lexical Units:**\n- `lexes` - Mapping between words and their linguistic properties\n- `lexes_morphs` - Links between lexical units and morphological forms\n- `lexes_pronunciations` - Links between lexical units and pronunciations\n- `lexrelations` - Semantic relations between lexical units\n\n**Senses (Word Meanings):**\n- `senses` - Individual word senses with sense keys and frequency information\n- `senses_adjpositions` - Adjective position constraints for specific senses\n- `senses_vframes` - Verb frames associated with senses\n- `senses_vtemplates` - Verb templates for senses\n\n**Relations & Examples:**\n- `relations` - Relation types with recursion flags\n- `semrelations` - Semantic relations between synsets\n- `samples` - Example sentences/usage samples\n- `usages` - Usage notes and definitions\n\n**Cross-references:**\n- `ilis` - Inter-Lingual Index mappings to synsets\n- `wikidatas` - Wikidata entity links to synsets\n\n**Verb-related:**\n- `vframes` - Verb frame definitions\n- `vtemplates` - Verb template patterns\n\nAll POS fields are constrained to: 'n' (noun), 'v' (verb), 'a' (adjective), 'r' (adverb), 's' (satellite adjective). This appears to be the Open English WordNet (OEWN) database schema."}]}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"cd21a2cc-fcfa-4067-bf1c-517a9e1a00fa","uuid":"193b243f-afaa-44e2-a409-5f360e66e65e","timestamp":"2026-05-13T18:39:57.582Z","tool_use_result":{"status":"completed","prompt":"Read the SQLite database schema at /app/oewn.sqlite. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-4-6","id":"msg_01QU4yaFQdevteGuA8WTWw8S","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01C9ZfkttNdQNv94JwjpZnZ3","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/app/sol.sql","content":"WITH word_synset_counts AS (\n  SELECT\n    s.wordid,\n    s.synsetid,\n    COUNT(*) AS sense_count\n  FROM senses s\n  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid\n),\nword_top_synset AS (\n  SELECT\n    wordid,\n    synsetid AS top_synsetid,\n    sense_count AS top_synset_sense_count,\n    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY sense_count DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn\n  FROM word_synset_counts\n),\nword_agg AS (\n  SELECT\n    w.wordid,\n    w.word,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT s.synsetid) AS total_synsets,\n    COUNT(*) AS total_senses,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.domainid) AS distinct_domains,\n    COUNT(DISTINCT syn.posid) AS distinct_posids\n  FROM words w\n  JOIN senses s ON w.wordid = s.wordid\n  JOIN synsets syn ON s.synsetid = syn.synsetid\n  GROUP BY w.wordid, w.word\n  HAVING total_synsets >= 2\n    AND distinct_domains >= 2\n    AND total_senses >= 2\n)\nSELECT\n  wa.wordid AS word_id,\n  wa.word,\n  wa.total_synsets,\n  wa.total_senses,\n  wa.distinct_domains,\n  wa.distinct_posids,\n  wts.top_synsetid,\n  wts.top_synset_sense_count\nFROM word_agg wa\nJOIN word_top_synset wts ON wa.wordid = wts.wordid AND wts.rn = 1\nORDER BY\n  wa.total_senses DESC,\n  wa.total_synsets DESC,\n  wa.distinct_domains DESC,\n  wa.wordid ASC\nLIMIT 500;\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":776,"cache_read_input_tokens":21348,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":776,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"cd21a2cc-fcfa-4067-bf1c-517a9e1a00fa","uuid":"3f472159-d99f-4066-9293-488c8c9381af"}
